description: RELATIVE window from today: forecasts that are still OPEN and whose due date is on or before today plus within_days (overdue open forecasts are included), oldest due date first. Use it for "what is due soon or overdue right now". For a fixed calendar range, or to include forecasts that already closed, use list_due instead. Returns at most `limit` entries (default 10, max 50) with total (all matches), count (returned) and truncated; if truncated, narrow within_days or use list_due. Futures essays are not included. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

limit.description: Maximum number of forecasts to return (default 10, max 50). The response reports total and truncated.

within_days.description: Include open forecasts due on or before today plus this many days (default 365, max 3650). 0 means due today or earlier. Already-due open forecasts are always included.

name: due_forecasts
